user.title: Hive Local TRV
user.description: Enter your Zigbee2MQTT base topic. TRVs are discovered automatically. Use Configure afterwards to set a boiler entity, geofencing, or enable diagnostic logging.

data_description.z2m_base_topic: Must match base_topic in your Zigbee2MQTT configuration (default: zigbee2mqtt)

abort.already_configured: This Zigbee2MQTT instance is already configured.

init.title: Configure Hive Local TRV
init.description: Optionally configure a boiler entity, geofencing persons, and diagnostic logging.

data_description.boiler_entity: This entity is turned on or off based on TRV heat demand. Supports climate, switch, and input_boolean.
data_description.person_entities: When all selected people leave home, frost protection activates automatically.
data_description.enable_diagnostics: When enabled, HIVE_DIAG entries are written to the HA log at WARNING level. Useful for troubleshooting — disable once everything is working.
